subject: Claim R8 Abuse, Fraud, and Adversarial Product Risks
summary: After detecting three-way overlap on R1 benefit semantics, this researcher preserves its already-published R1 evidence but stops further R1 expansion and pivots to the first clearly unclaimed manager assignment: R8. Scope is provider impersonation, fabricated verification/availability, benefit misuse incentives, social engineering, approval spoofing/replay, and prompt/data poisoning affecting research or transaction routing.

lane.completion_target: threat catalog, severity/likelihood assessment, prevent-detect-recover controls, red-team test scenarios
